inputs.question: On the electrical plan, which direction does each transformer pad's access door face, and does it have at least 10 feet clearance to buildings or enclosed areas?
inputs.checklistItemText: Transformer pad hot-stick use area (access door side) lacks minimum 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent building/structure
inputs.classifierReasoning: The agent is asking for both directional identification (which direction the access door faces) and clearance distance verification (at least 10 feet to buildings/enclosed areas). The clearance component is the primary compliance question and requires plan-view distance measurement between the transformer pad access door and nearby structures.
